question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**accelerated**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about the ongoing issue of soil erosion and how it has worsened due to new demands placed on the land. "Accelerated" fits the context, meaning that the erosion process has sped up or worsened over time.
 
• "Accelerated" conveys the idea that the conservation efforts have not been enough to slow down or stop the problem, and instead, the problem has gotten worse due to increased crop production demands.
 
• Other options ("hindered", "discouraged", "delayed") imply that the problem has been slowed or prevented, which contradicts the passage's description of ongoing and worsening soil erosion.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Erosion of America's farmland by wind and water (1)_____ a problem since settlers first put the prairies and grasslands (2)______ the plow in the 19th century. By the 1930s, more than 282 million acres of farmland were (3)______ by erosion. After 40 years of conservation efforts, soil erosion has (4) accelerated__ due to new demands placed (5)____ the land by heavy crop production.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Accelerated" is the most appropriate word in this context as it aligns with the idea of soil erosion worsening due to the increased demands on the land.
 
• "Hindered", "discouraged", and "delayed" suggest that the erosion process has been slowed down or prevented, which does not match the context of worsening erosion described in the passage.
